index.subtitulo: Automation panel to configure, optimize and customize your Fedora Linux quickly and safely.
index.card_guiado_desc: Follow the Fedora configuration sessions step by step, in the right order — the order matters for the end result, so this is the only way to go through them.
index.card_manut_desc: Everyday tasks that don't depend on order: manage kernels, clean temporary files, adjust GRUB, update or uninstall FOF.
index.sobre_texto: FOF is an open-source tool that automates the main Fedora Linux setup tasks, from installing codecs and repositories to optimizing the system and managing kernels.
index.dica1: Progress of each action saved automatically on the local server
index.dica2: State of each action saved automatically, without relying on reports
index.dica5: Commands validated and tested for Fedora
index.dica6: Support for GNOME, KDE, XFCE and more
index.footer_creditos: Fedora Only Fans — Made with ❤️ by VitãoTub
index.footer_legal: Fedora is a registered trademark of Red Hat, Inc. This project is not affiliated with Red Hat.

00-boas-vindas.descricao: Before proceeding with the configuration and app installation steps, a complete update of your operating system is highly recommended.
00-boas-vindas.atualizacao_desc: Updates the repository index, synchronizes security keys and downloads the latest versions of all system components.
00-boas-vindas.aviso_reiniciar: 💡 It's recommended to restart your computer after applying system updates, whether directly through the FOF interface or via Fedora's own notification. Restarting ensures that all changes are applied correctly and prevents potential inconsistencies in the system's operation.

01-restauracao.btrfs_desc: Btrfs-Assistant is a graphical tool to manage snapshots of the Btrfs filesystem, allowing you to create and restore backups of your system.
01-restauracao.info_extra: ℹ️ Btrfs-Assistant lets you create snapshots before making changes to the system, ensuring you can restore if something goes wrong.

02-otimizacao.dnf_desc: Configures simultaneous parallel downloads and enables automatic lookup of the fastest server mirror.
02-otimizacao.dnf_info_extra: ℹ️ The setting will be applied with the selected value. You can reapply with different values at any time.
02-otimizacao.idioma_desc: Install translation packages, spell checker, and change the system default locale:
02-otimizacao.idioma_aviso: ⚠️ Note: Restart your computer after completing step 3 to apply the language changes!
02-otimizacao.dual_boot_desc: Makes Fedora use the hardware clock in local time (the same way Windows does by default), fixing the wrong time when switching between systems.
02-otimizacao.dual_boot_aviso: 💡 By default, Windows stores the hardware clock in local time, while Linux (Fedora) stores it in UTC. When you switch between the two, each system interprets the clock differently and the time appears wrong. This button configures Fedora to use local time, matching Windows' behavior — so you don't need to change anything on Windows.

03-repositorios.rpm_titulo: Enable RPM Fusion Repositories (Free and Non-Free)
03-repositorios.rpm_desc: Installs and synchronizes the official RPM Fusion repositories, adds AppStream metadata support and runs a security adjustment.
03-repositorios.flatpak_desc: Adds the global Flathub repository and ensures the Flatpak package manager is installed on the system.
03-repositorios.codecs_desc: Replaces ffmpeg-free with the full unrestricted version, installs essential gstreamer plugins and enables Cisco OpenH264.
03-repositorios.extras_desc: Enables restricted sub-repositories to enable commercial DVD playback and proprietary firmware.

04-fontes.fontes_desc: Installs the Microsoft fonts installer from SourceForge to get Arial, Times, Calibri, etc.
04-fontes.fontes_aviso: ⚠️ This process downloads and installs proprietary Microsoft fonts. Make sure you comply with the licensing terms.
04-fontes.info_extra: ℹ️ Fonts installed: Arial, Times New Roman, Calibri, Cambria, Candara, Consolas, Constantia, Corbel, and others.

05-launchers.launchers_desc: Install the main game launchers and essential packages for Fedora.
05-launchers.launchers_info: ℹ️ All launchers are installed via Flatpak.
05-launchers.compat_desc: Tools to run Windows games and programs outside of Steam, and features that help performance while gaming.
05-launchers.compat_info_extra: ℹ️ Winetricks installs extra components (fonts, libraries) inside a Wine prefix. Bottles is a modern alternative to plain Wine, with visual management of "bottles" (prefixes) and Proton-GE runner support. GameMode sets CPU/GPU to maximum priority while a game is running. MangoHud shows an FPS/CPU/GPU overlay inside the game.

06-loja.obs_titulo: 🎬 OBS Studio - Installation and Virtual Camera
06-loja.obs_desc: Install OBS Studio for recording/streaming and enable the virtual camera for video calls.
06-loja.obs_aviso: ⚠️ The virtual camera requires Secure Boot to be configured correctly or disabled.
06-loja.easyeffects_desc: Sound effects processor for PipeWire to apply noise reduction and equalization.

10-hardware.descricao: Configuration specific to your hardware: choose the GPU type (AMD or NVIDIA) below to see the corresponding drivers and tools. The controls block is useful for any card.
10-hardware.vulkan_desc: Installs the Vulkan libraries (32-bit and 64-bit), Mesa 3D with the RADV driver (AMD's open-source Vulkan driver), diagnostic tools and compatibility drivers. Essential for Steam, Proton and native games.
10-hardware.vaapi_desc: Hardware video acceleration drivers for smooth playback and encoding. RPM Fusion (Session 4) is a prerequisite for the freeworld version.
10-hardware.vaapi_aviso: 💡 Both buttons install VA-API drivers. The first uses Fedora's default driver; the second applies mesa-va-drivers-freeworld, an alternative for AMD GPUs that don't work with the default. If you're unsure, use the first one.
10-hardware.corectrl_desc: GUI for fan, clock and voltage control on AMD GPUs.
10-hardware.lact_desc: Modern alternative to CoreCtrl for fan, clock and voltage control on AMD GPUs.
10-hardware.overclock_desc: Enables the amdgpu.ppfeaturemask kernel parameter, unlocking advanced clock and voltage adjustments in CoreCtrl and LACT.
10-hardware.overclock_aviso: ⚠️ Requires reboot. Only enable if you know what you're doing — bad overclock can cause instability.
10-hardware.nvidia_aviso: ⚠️ Without nvidia-drm.modeset=1, Wayland is unstable with NVIDIA cards. RPM Fusion (Session 4) is a prerequisite for proprietary drivers. After installing anything here, reboot your computer.
10-hardware.nvidia_driver_desc: Installs akmod-nvidia (recompilable module on every new kernel) and the CUDA + NVENC/NVDEC library extras for OBS, Kdenlive and hardware encoding.
10-hardware.nvidia_modeset_desc: Enables the nvidia-drm.modeset=1 kernel parameter, required for Wayland to work correctly with NVIDIA cards.
10-hardware.coolercontrol_desc: GUI for fan control. Supports NVIDIA and AMD. Replaces GreenWithEnvy (which is abandoned).
10-hardware.input_add_desc: Required for Steam Input, xpadneo and controller drivers to recognize the user. Works for Xbox, PlayStation and Nintendo controllers using kernel drivers.
10-hardware.input_add_aviso: ℹ️ Requires logout/login to take effect.

11-waydroid.aviso_nvidia: ⚠️ Waydroid requires AMD or Intel GPU. Users with NVIDIA GPU cannot use this session (the proprietary driver doesn't expose the required Mesa). There's an experimental project (waydroid-nvidia) that tries to work around it via Vulkan proxy, but it's not supported by FOF.
11-waydroid.descricao: Waydroid runs Android inside a container on Fedora. This session installs Waydroid, initializes the container with the Android image, and offers the most requested extras (Google Play Store, ARM translation, Magisk, Widevine).
11-waydroid.waydroid_desc: Installs Waydroid and lzip (dependency for the extras script). We use the COPR yanqiyu/waydroid because the official package is broken on Fedora 44 (Bug 2420131) and the COPR has the working version for Fedora 44/45.
11-waydroid.init_desc: Downloads the Android images (system ~1.2 GB + vendor ~190 MB) and initializes the container. Uses the GAPPS variant (with Google Apps). Runs once — after that, use "Open Waydroid" to start the container whenever you want.
11-waydroid.open_desc: Opens the Android interface. Starts the container if it's not running. The container must be running to install extras (GApps, Magisk, etc.). Click here once before using the extras.
11-waydroid.uninstall_desc: Removes Waydroid and all container data (images, installed Android apps, settings). Irreversible action.
11-waydroid.confirmar_uninstall: This will remove Waydroid and ALL Android container data (installed apps, settings). Continue?
11-waydroid.prep_desc: Clones waydroid_script, creates an isolated Python environment (venv) and installs dependencies. This step is a prerequisite for all extras below. Runs once.
11-waydroid.prep_aviso: ⚠️ Requires Waydroid to be installed, initialized AND with the container running (use "Open Waydroid" above). Without that, the extras fail.
11-waydroid.gapps_desc: Installs Google apps, including the Google Play Store, in the Android container. Requires the Extras Environment to be prepared and the container running.
11-waydroid.arm_desc: Allows running Android apps compiled for ARM on x86_64 machines. libndk usually has better performance on AMD CPUs; libhoudini is the traditional option for Intel. Install only one of them.
11-waydroid.magisk_desc: Advanced suite for Android users. Provides root and module management inside the container. Requires the Extras Environment to be prepared.
11-waydroid.widevine_desc: DRM L3 support for services like Netflix, Spotify and other streaming inside the Android container. Requires the Extras Environment to be prepared.
11-waydroid.smartdock_desc: Support for Logitech SmartDock hardware. Requires the Extras Environment to be prepared.
11-waydroid.helper_desc: GUI for advanced Waydroid configuration. Downloads the latest AppImage from GitHub and opens it.
11-waydroid.prefs_desc: Applies tweaks that improve usability (independent windows, proper DPI, touch behavior in games).
11-waydroid.prefs_aviso: ⚠️ The Waydroid container must be running for these settings to apply. Open Waydroid once before using this button.
11-waydroid.container_running: Waydroid container is running. You can install the extras.
11-waydroid.container_stopped: Waydroid container is not running. Click "Open Waydroid" in the section above before using the extras.
11-waydroid.container_not_ready: Waydroid is not installed or initialized yet. Follow the steps in the section above first.
11-waydroid.container_waiting: Waiting for the container to come up (up to 60 seconds)...
11-waydroid.container_timeout: Container did not respond within 60s. Check /tmp/fof-waydroid-ui.log for details.
11-waydroid.container_guard_alert: Waydroid container is not running. Click "Open Waydroid" first.

07-manutencao.limpeza_desc: Cleans the DNF cache, orphaned dependencies and unused Flatpak runtimes.
07-manutencao.kernel_desc: Manage the kernels installed on your system.
07-manutencao.kernel_aviso: ⚠️ IMPORTANT: Removing an older kernel version is not recommended because Fedora keeps only the last 3 kernels.

07-manutencao.grub_desc: Configure GRUB to always show when the computer turns on and set the display time to 10 seconds.
07-manutencao.grub_aviso: ⚠️ This change affects system boot. Make sure GRUB is installed correctly.
07-manutencao.grub_confirmar_recomendado:
⚠️ Apply the recommended GRUB configuration?

• GRUB will always show on boot

07-manutencao.grub_confirmar_padrao: Restore default GRUB configuration (timeout=5 seconds, hidden)?

08-fof-manutencao.atualizar_desc: Downloads and installs the latest version of FOF directly from GitHub. Keep your app always up to date!
08-fof-manutencao.atualizar_info: ℹ️ Updating keeps your settings and history.
08-fof-manutencao.atualizar_confirmar:
🔄 Update Fedora Only Fans to the latest version?

This will download and install the latest version from GitHub.
08-fof-manutencao.desinstalar_desc: Completely removes FOF from your system, including all files, settings and shortcuts.
08-fof-manutencao.desinstalar_aviso: ⚠️ WARNING: This action is irreversible! All FOF data will be removed.
08-fof-manutencao.desinstalar_confirmar1:

09-softwares-uteis.bloco1_desc: Tools to work with documents, notes, email and e-books.
09-softwares-uteis.bloco2_desc: Video, music and streaming players to consume content day to day.
09-softwares-uteis.bloco3_desc: Image editing, vector illustration, 3D modeling, CAD and 3D printing.
09-softwares-uteis.bloco4_desc: Browsers, video call apps and messengers.
09-softwares-uteis.bloco5a_desc: Video editors for cuts, montages and advanced projects, plus 3D modeling.
09-softwares-uteis.bloco6_desc: Tools to sync files with Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox and other services.
09-softwares-uteis.affinity_desc: Affinity has no native Linux version. This button opens the AffinityOnLinux installer, a community project (not affiliated with Serif/Canva) that sets up a pre-configured Wine environment to run Affinity.
09-softwares-uteis.affinity_aviso: ⚠️ You must have purchased and downloaded the Affinity .exe installer from the official Serif/Canva website before using this — FOF only prepares the Wine environment and opens the community installer; that installer will ask for the .exe file at the right moment. It's a third-party project: if something doesn't work on your hardware, check their known issues page.
09-softwares-uteis.affinity_prereq: 📦 Prerequisite: PyQt6 is required for the installer interface. FOF checks and installs it automatically if needed.
09-softwares-uteis.lightworks_aviso: ⚠️ Note: Lightworks is not installed via Flatpak. The button downloads the RPM package directly from the official LWKS website. Updates are not automatic — to update, run this button again.
09-softwares-uteis.rclone_aviso: ℹ️ Cloud account setup: Rclone Manager is a graphical interface for Rclone. It lets you configure access to Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, S3, and dozens of other cloud storage services. After installing both apps, open Rclone Manager and follow the guide inside its interface to add your accounts. FOF only installs the tools — setting up the accounts is done by you, inside Rclone Manager.
